name: Cremicro AI Summary Links
author: Cremicro Digital Marketing

sections.description:
Cremicro AI Summary Links is a lightweight, privacy-focused WordPress extension by Cremicro that allows visitors to summarize posts, pages, and custom post types across popular AI services including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, and Google Search AI Mode.

Why This Plugin?

Unlike basic summary link plugins, Cremicro AI Summary Links provides a complete, customizable client-side integration:
* Google AI Mode Support: Direct integration with Google Search AI Mode (udm=50).
* Brand & Domain-Aware Queries: Automatically ensures your brand name and domain context are included in AI search queries.
* Dynamic Placeholders: Customize prompt templates using {url}, {site_name}, {site_url}, {post_title}, {post_type}, {author_name}, {brand_name}, and {brand_url}.
* Flexible Post Type Support: Works on standard posts, pages, and public custom post types.
* Automatic & Manual Placement: Place buttons automatically (before content, after first paragraph, after content) or manually via [cremicro_ai_summary_links].
* Per-Content Exclusions: Easily exclude specific posts via post ID lists or the post edit screen meta box.
* No API Keys or Server Requests: Operates completely client-side without API fees or background server calls.

Third-Party Services

Cremicro AI Summary Links provides direct client-side quick links to external AI assistants and search tools.

How Data Is Handled

  • No Server-Side API Calls: This plugin does not send page content or site data to AI providers from your WordPress server.
  • Client-Side Redirects: When a visitor clicks a button, their browser opens the selected provider’s website with a prepared query or prompt containing the page URL and title.
  • Third-Party Terms & Privacy: Visitors interact directly with third-party websites under those providers’ respective Terms of Service and Privacy Policies.

Provider Directories & Policies

  • ChatGPT / OpenAI

    • Service: https://chatgpt.com/
    • Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
    • Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

  • Claude / Anthropic

    • Service: https://claude.ai/
    • Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
    • Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

  • Perplexity

    • Service: https://www.perplexity.ai/
    • Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/terms-of-service
    • Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-notice

  • Grok / xAI

    • Service: https://grok.com/
    • Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service
    • Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy

  • Google AI Mode / Google Search

    • Service: https://www.google.com/
    • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Disclaimer

ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, and Google are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective owners. This plugin is an independent extension developed by Cremicro and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of these providers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cremicro-ai-summary-links folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP file directly via your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Cremicro AI Summary Links to configure your prompt template and display preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. The plugin creates dynamic pre-filled search/prompt links and opens the AI service directly in the visitor’s browser. No backend API key is needed.

How do I use the shortcode?

Add [cremicro_ai_summary_links] anywhere in your content, theme templates, or page builders.
